primary_reference.title: A dataset of rated conceptual arguments

observations: The reference reports 951 rated critiques, 1458 ratings, 442 positions with at least one rated critique, and 279 positions with at least two rated critiques.
The reference reports strong concentration in one primary rater and recommends more double-rated or double-checked critiques in later releases.
The reference identifies source and writing-style confounding, too few positions with a useful spread of critique quality, and interpretation-driven disagreement as important limitations.
The reference treats strength multiplied by centrality as the relevant substantive-impact quantity and branches to clarity plus overall when human clarity is below 0.5.
The reference preserves original ratings when discussion or object-level reconsideration produces a revision.

preferred_assignment.fallback_rule: If independent source-fidelity and ambiguity review makes the preferred six-six crossing infeasible, preserve at least four positions from each source class, maximize one-of-each-source topic crossing, and document every deviation before Q-006B.
invariants: Each of the 12 positions is assigned to exactly two core raters.
Each core rater receives exactly four positions and sixteen critique ratings.
No anonymous rater pair is repeated.
Each core rater works with four distinct other raters.
Each core rater receives four distinct topic families.
Under the preferred six-six source mix, each core rater receives two positions from each source class.
Under the preferred six-six source mix, each topic family contains one position from each source class.

required_preselection_diagnostics: candidate source and author or model identity
rules: Use acquisition-judge strata only to construct a difficult and varied candidate set; never treat them as labels.
Do not select a set in which provisional quality is trivially predictable from length, formatting, citation style, or source identity.
Do not rewrite substantive critique text merely to conceal its source; instead record residual cue risk and include it in limitations and sensitivity analysis.
Freeze all candidate-selection diagnostics and exclusion reasons before human rating.

issue_coverage: a critique that may already be priced in to the position
dead weight versus unsuccessful substantive argument
sequence: Independent blind scoring of all eight public calibration critiques.
Lock and preserve every initial calibration rating.
Reveal a rubric-based considerations dossier rather than a single unquestionable gold vector.
Discuss large differences using object-level reasons, with no instruction to conform merely because another rater disagrees.
Record a pass, targeted-remediation, or non-selection disposition under the later frozen qualification rule.
shared_calibration.qualification_boundary: No numerical calibration pass threshold is binding before methodological-adviser review and explicit project-owner approval.
shared_calibration.exclusion: Calibration items are public, non-protected, excluded from the 48-critique pilot, and excluded from the pilot outcome analysis.

required_item_review_candidates.reason: The reference methodology treats other dimension scores as unreliable or less meaningful when clarity is below 0.5.
A correctness disagreement should not be resolved by confidence or averaging when a practical verification step remains open.

adjudication_additions.routing_rule: These are candidates for item and evidence review, not automatic pressure on a rater to revise. Original ratings remain preserved.

uncertainty_and_sensitivity: Report all 12 position-level results rather than only pooled point estimates.
Use position as the resampling or leave-one-out unit because four sibling critiques share context.
Report leave-one-position-out ranges for primary agreement summaries.
Label ICC, Krippendorff alpha, model comparisons, and subgroup effects exploratory and provide uncertainty intervals.
Keep pre-adjudication and post-adjudication results separate.
small_sample_limits: Do not make a causal claim that one source class, topic family, model family, or rater type is superior from this 12-position pilot.
Do not rank individual raters publicly from sixteen production ratings.
Do not treat passing provisional scale-readiness thresholds as sufficient evidence to activate Phase 2 automatically.
analysis_safeguards.model_baseline_boundary: Freeze model identities, versions, prompts, sampling parameters, retries, and output parsing before protected human ratings; use model judgments as baselines, not labels or adjudicators.

approval_sequence: Q-006A may approve these elements for consultation and non-final screening.
Methodological-adviser comments and feasibility findings are recorded with dispositions.
Q-006B freezes the final assignment, source mix, calibration rule, adjudication triggers, analysis plan, and exact protected items.

unresolved_parameters: Whether the preferred six-six source crossing is feasible after independent source-fidelity and ambiguity review.
The exact public calibration positions, critiques, considerations dossier, remediation rule, and qualification threshold.
The final low-clarity and unresolved-verification routing rules.
The final uncertainty method and any pre-registered numerical scale-readiness thresholds.
The mapping from anonymous rater slots to qualified named participants after conflict and exposure screening.
